questions.question: What is the ratio of outpatient to inpatient followed up treatment among all the 'SLE' diagnosed patient?
questions.evidence: 'SLE' diagnosed patient means fld008 = 'SLE'; inpatient refers to fld018 = '+'; outpatient refers to fld018 = '-'; calculation =  DIVIDE(COUNT(fld001) where fld008 = 'SLE' and fld018 = '+', COUNT(fld001) where fld008 = 'SLE' and fld018 = '-')
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fld018 = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN fld018 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 WHERE fld008 = 'SLE'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

questions.question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
questions.evidence: How old the patient refers to SUBTRACT(year(fld002), year(fld015)); the highest hemoglobin count refers to MAX(fld036)
questions.SQL: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld019) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015), T1.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 ORDER BY T2.fld036 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday), T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID ORDER BY T2.HGB DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the patients who have an abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase, when was the youngest of them born?
questions.evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to fld020 > = 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld015 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld020 >= 60 ORDER BY T1.fld015 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
questions.evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to fld038 <= 100 or fld038 >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to fld038 < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(fld038 < 100), SUM(fld038 > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to fld038 > 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld038 <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld038 >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

questions.question: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
questions.evidence: List refers to GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fld001); total bilirubin (T-BIL) not within normal range refers to T-BIL > = 2.0
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld001, T1.fld014 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld029 >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.fld014, T1.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.ID,T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX,T1.ID

questions.question: How many patients with an Ig G higher than normal?
questions.evidence: Ig G higher than normal refers to fld046 >= 2000; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T3.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld046 >= 2000
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000

questions.question: For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years old with normal platelet level.
questions.evidence: laboratory examinations take in 1984 refers to YEAR(fld019) = '1984'; below 50 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)) < 50; normal platelet level refers to fld038 between 100 and 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld038 BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld019) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld019) = '1984'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
